LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 10.3.1 WORD CLASSES: DETERMINERS AND QUANTIFIERS

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 10
Topic 10.3: Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Word Classes: Determiners and Quantifiers
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Word Classes: Determiners and Quantifiers, part of Strand 10 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why do we use demonstratives and quantifiers? 2. How can we use demonstratives and quantifiers in a text?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Word Classes: Determiners and Quantifiers together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and collaboration: The learners work in pairs and show teamwork.

● Self-efficacy through effective communication is developed as the learner practises the correct use of demonstratives and

quantifiers

Values:
Love is exhibited through care and compassion as the learners assist each other in group work.
